test_title: PYST 60: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Martha made pancakes yesterday.

options.text: Pancakes had been made by Martha yesterday.
Pancakes were being made by Martha yesterday.
Pancakes were made by Martha yesterday.
Pancakes was made by Martha yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Martha made pancakes yesterday."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "pancakes" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "made" to "were made" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Martha."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "yesterday" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Pancakes were made by Martha yesterday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Pancakes had been made by Martha yesterday." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"Pancakes were being made by Martha yesterday." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"Pancakes was made by Martha yesterday." – Subject-verb agreement error.
